haikus.haiku:
Cider cups steam bright
Orchard whispers sweet amber
Hands stir warm honey
Happy #NationalBrandiedFruitDay from @ClamBakeSanta

soft steam curls in night
flavors dance on bright plates glow
joyful hands stir love
Happy #InternationalChefsDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunlight drips on leaves
Soft breeze hums through quiet trees
Joy twirls in bright cheer
#HappyBirthdayArthurRimbaud from @ClamBakeSanta
